description: Scala source file defining the StreamingQueryProgressSerializer object for serializing and deserializing StreamingQueryProgress objects to and from protobuf format, including handling of observed metrics as JSON strings.

classes.name: StreamingQueryProgressSerializer
classes.description: Object providing methods to serialize and deserialize StreamingQueryProgress objects to protobuf format.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a StreamingQueryProgress object into protobuf StoreTypes.StreamingQueryProgress.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes protobuf StoreTypes.StreamingQueryProgress into a StreamingQueryProgress object.

methods.name: putAllObservedMetrics
methods.description: Encodes observed metrics Row objects as JSON strings and adds them to the protobuf builder.

methods.name: convertToObservedMetrics
methods.description: Converts a map of JSON strings to a map of Row objects representing observed metrics.
